headline: Volume guidance maintained

highlights: Revenue was inline with estimates at INR438.8bn (PLe: INR434.7bn; BBGe: INR441.5bn), down 5.6% QoQ and up 32.8% YoY.
EBITDA was largely inline with estimates but declined 10.6% QoQ and increased 48.7% YoY to INR263.2bn (PLe: INR260.2bn; BBGe: INR268.3bn).
PAT came above estimates at INR154.9bn (PLe: INR141.5bn; BBGe: INR136.7bn), declining 9.1% QoQ but growing 57.3% YoY, supported by higher other income and a lower tax.
Oil vol sales as a % of production declined YoY: ONGC's oil sales volume declined 7.2% YoY / 1.0% QoQ to 4.2MMT, while JV oil sales declined 25.6% YoY but increased 4.5% QoQ to 0.2MMT.
